prompt: Edit this precise LPC pixel sprite strip. THREE equal square cells in a horizontal row with the same reference positions and directions: down/front, right profile, back. Preserve this female NPC's exact existing design: chin-length silver-gray bob hair, tied navy headband with narrow back tails, navy-blue sleeveless crossover dress with long skirt and navy obi sash, bare arms and hands, brown slippers mostly hidden by skirt. Make ONLY a very small respectful chin-down nod: head, bob hair, headband and tails moving together about ONE logical pixel lower. Keep the original head size, face, short bob silhouette, body proportions and simple chunky LPC source colors. Do not lengthen hair or redesign the dress. All arms, hands, chest garment below collar, waist, skirt and feet remain stationary and faithful to the input. Transparent background with generous blank margins, same 3:1 proportions as the 768x256 reference and crisp enlarged pixel grid. No new ornaments, weapons, props, labels, text, glow, shadow, base or floor. A tiny dialogue opening acknowledgment, not casting or attacking.
